data.name: Farishteh
data.gender_notes: Farishteh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Farishteh refers to a heavenly being or a messenger of God, symbolizing peace and tranquility. The name Farishteh carries the meaning “Angelic being” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farishteh usually hope their child will grow to embody angelic being and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the qualities of a guardian angel, guiding and protecting the individual.
data.etymology: Farishteh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Angelic being.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farishteh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

This name is not just beautiful but also carries a sense of mystery, reflecting the rich and diverse history of Persian and Islamic culture.
